notices.summary: Field-truth is compiled from the upstream sources below. Most are open data and may be redistributed; nearly all require visible attribution, and some restrict commercial use. Surface attribution for any source whose data appears in your response (each claim carries its `source`).

sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (data); free API is non-commercial only
sources.note: Data is CC BY 4.0, but the free API tier is non-commercial. A commercial product must use an Open-Meteo paid plan.

sources.attribution: Based on data from MET Norway
sources.note: Requires an identifying User-Agent and respect for their traffic terms.

sources.attribution: Space weather data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
Air quality data via OpenAQ (CC BY 4.0)

sources.note: OSM data is freely redistributable, but the public Nominatim/Overpass endpoints prohibit production and reseller use. A product must run its own instances.

sources.dataType: river/canal/tide-gauge water level, trend, and flood warnings (England, #99)
sources.attribution: Contains Environment Agency data © Environment Agency and database right, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0
sources.note: Real-time flood-monitoring API, no key required. England only — see hydro.stationLevel.coverage.

sources.dataType: recent bird observations (Cornell Lab of Ornithology)
sources.license: eBird API Terms of Use — proprietary
sources.attribution: Bird observations: eBird, Cornell Lab of Ornithology
sources.note: Commercial use and redistribution require written permission from the Cornell Lab (ebird@cornell.edu). Use a bring-your-own-key arrangement so the consumer is the licensee.

sources.license: per-observation; default CC BY-NC, some all-rights-reserved
sources.note: Default observation license is non-commercial. For a commercial product, filter to open-licensed records (license=cc0,cc-by) so non-redistributable observations are structurally absent.

sources.license: Per-record CC0 1.0 or CC BY 4.0; filtered
sources.attribution: Occurrence evidence via GBIF; credit the original linked datasets and records.
sources.note: Historical sample only. Every displayed candidate must retain original dataset attribution; media rights are separate.

sources.license: Per-entry reviewed dataset licence; current subset OGL-UK-3.0
sources.attribution: Relationships indexed by GloBI; credit the original study and dataset carried on each entry.
sources.note: A published relationship is not a local interaction. Only the reviewed versioned subset is served.

sources.attribution: USA National Phenology Network and its data contributors; retain the response dataset citations.
sources.note: Preserve original dataset identity, including NEON where applicable. Reported status applies to its dated site observation.

sources.attribution: PhenoCam Network and contributing site scientists; preserve the source response credit.
sources.note: Provisional camera-region evidence; camera location does not describe the viewed footprint.

sources.attribution: City of Boston Parks and Recreation Department, BPRD Trees.
sources.note: Publisher inventory points, not confirmed present trees or verified access.

sources.dataType: station-reference tide predictions and measured levels
sources.attribution: NOAA CO-OPS; preserve the station, datum, units and each product date.
sources.note: Station data do not establish conditions or access at the query point.

sources.attribution: SoilGrids 2.0, ISRIC — World Soil Information (CC BY 4.0); contains modified SoilGrids data.
sources.note: Native 250m model with depth and uncertainty, not a schoolyard measurement.

sources.license: Copernicus free, full and open access
sources.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data; retain acquisition years and Element 84 Earth Search credit.
sources.note: A two-date NDVI comparison, not HR-VPP, a current phenophase or an ecological trend.
